items.reason: Eligibility goes beyond glioblastoma: 'WHO grade 4 astrocytoma or WHO grade high grade glioma' and 'All grade 4 gliomas ... may be included, as the prognosis ... may not differ based on IDH mutation status', i.e. IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is explicitly allowed. D27C counts grade 4 astrocytoma as glioblastoma only without an IDH statement; here IDH-mutant tumours are expressly admitted, so several glioma types are eligible with glioblastoma named.
regimen counts all antitumour therapy in the experimental arms; Regimen B is 'Retifanlimab+RT+bevacizumab+epacadostat', so epacadostat is a partner of retifanlimab there.

note: Either population value keeps the trial included; the choice only affects the GBM-only sensitivity analysis. Retifanlimab is the only investigational agent in Regimen A (monotherapy there); both coders coded experimental_combination overall, which does not change candidate status.
